newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Korea Mobile plummets on price war.
newsitem.headline: Korea Mobile plummets on price war.

text.p: Shares of Korea Mobile Telecom fell sharply due to growing competition with newly-launched Shinsegi Telecomm Inc over subscription fees, brokers said on Thursday.
Korea Mobile fell 37,000 won to 435,500 in late afternoon trading. It briefly touched the lower limit of 435,000.

"Shinsegi's initiative to cut fees for subscribers will likely trigger a price war in the mobile phone market. That will hurt Korea Mobile's profit margins," said Dongwon Securities' broker Choo Hee-yup.
Shinsegi, one of South Korea's two mobile telephone operators, said on Thursday it would sharply cut fees for new subscribers effective Saturday.
It said it plans to cut the expense of deposits, sign-up fees and a handset to 360,000 won from around 700,000 won at present. --Seoul Newsroom (822) 727 5645
